web.survival.empty: No records yet this week. Be the first!
web.survival.rules:
Pick the first stage of a Pokémon you've caught (or one that doesn't evolve) and survive 10 minutes against swarms of wild Pokémon. Attacks are automatic; you only move. (WASD / arrow keys, or press and drag)
It evolves at run level 8, and again at 16, changing its look and stats. If it can evolve into more than one, you choose.
Every Pokémon uses the same baseline (Lv.50), so your Pokémon's level and training don't matter. Only base stats and 4 moves differ by Pokémon. Moves change every run: they are drawn from the evolution line's moves learned by Lv.50 and its signature moves in competitive play, and signature moves come up more often.
Collect the candies foes drop to level up, then pick a new move or an upgrade.
Elites sometimes drop items: 🧲 Magnet pulls in every candy, ❄️ Ice freezes foes for 4 seconds, 💥 Blast clears everything nearby.
From 1:30, a swarm crosses the screen every 2 minutes.
From 4:00, fast rushers (orange glow underfoot) join the horde.
A legendary boss appears at 2, 4, 6 and 8 minutes, each tougher than the last. Beating one gives two level-ups and some HP.
Ranking goes by time survived, then by KOs. Only your best this week goes to the weekly ranking when signed in, shown with its final form.
Your lead Pokémon needs at least {0} energy to start, and ends up hungry and tired. You earn training, bond and items.
